symbols.description: Namespaces, classes or functions. "std" matches std::* and std<...>; '*' and '?' are wildcards; "module!pattern" also checks the module.

files.description: Source files or directories. Absolute paths match as prefixes, relative ones anywhere in the path; '*' and '?' are wildcards; ${workspaceFolder} is supported.

modules.description: Module names without extension; '*' and '?' are wildcards.

inheritDefaults.description: Keep the built-in external rules (STL, CRT, Windows SDK and system modules).

external.description: Code matching these rules is external: stepping skips it and the call stack collapses it.

user.description: Code matching these rules is always user code, even when an external rule matches.
